# Functionality matrix

What libSACM implements, requirement by requirement. The canonical source is [`functionality-matrix.toml`](functionality-matrix.toml); the row format, status vocabulary and gate rules are described in [README.md](README.md). `SACM23-*` rows are obligations of the OMG SACM 2.3 standard; `LIB-*` rows are library capabilities and quality commitments.

| SACM23-XMI-001 | **Interchange roots.** `xmi::read` returns `Ok(ReadOutput)` with a `Document` (and its diagnostics, sorted per ADR 0011; none yet) when every interchange root is an `AssuranceCasePackage` or `ArgumentPackage` element in the pinned SACM namespace `http://www.omg.org/spec/SACM/20220301` (D-NS-PIN). A root is the document element, or each element child outside the XMI namespace of an `XMI` element in the XMI 2.5.1 namespace `http://www.omg.org/spec/XMI/20131001`. Elements and attributes are matched by namespace URI and local name, never by prefix (any-prefix equivalence is SACM23-XMI-002). Each root becomes a parentless element of its kind, in document order, whose id is its `xmi:id` exactly and whose name is missing (ADR 0013). A read root may carry only namespace declarations, `xmi:id`, `xmi:version` (ignored: XMI 2.5.1 identifies its version by namespace) and an `xmi:type` or `xsi:type` naming its own class; its content may be only white space, comments and processing instructions. The wrapper may carry only namespace declarations and `xmi:version`. Anything else is refused as `ReadError::Unsupported` at its location, never dropped (LIB-API-009): a child element or any other attribute of a root, non-white-space text, a root whose `xmi:id` is absent, empty or repeats an earlier root's, the other ten package kinds as roots (SACM23-ART-001, SACM23-TERM-001, AC-002/003, ARG-014/015), a package-kind name in another namespace or none (LIB-COMPAT-004), an `XMI` element in another namespace (LIB-COMPAT-002), and an XMI-namespace element as a root or wrapper child (SACM23-XMI-019). A root or wrapper child whose local name is none of the twelve package-kind names, and a wrapper with no root, are refused with a `ReadError` whose `code()` is SACM-XMI-001, at that element; among the refusals found while reading the roots this takes precedence over `Unsupported`, so which roots get SACM-XMI-001 does not depend on what a release can read (an `XMI` element outside the XMI namespace is `Unsupported` before its children are classified, ADR 0016 D1). No document is returned beside a refusal (ADR 0015). The XML checks of LIB-SEC-005 run before any root is classified.<br>_Note: Parser leniencies beyond LIB-SEC-005's list are open until LIB-SEC-006 (W3C conformance suite), by the maintainer's decision Subclasses inherit roles, package interfaces and bindings included. A test reads the suite's 21 catalogs and runs through `xmi::read` every TEST with TYPE `not-wf`, RECOMMENDATION XML1.0 (the default), XML1.0-errata2e/3e/4e, NS1.0 or NS1.0-errata1e, VERSION absent or listing 1.0, and EDITION absent or listing 5. Each is refused: `Malformed` or `Doctype`, or `Unsupported` only from the encoding steps; a root-stage result (`Ok`, `InvalidRoot`, `NoPackage`, root-stage `Unsupported`) counts as accepted, because the suite's documents are not SACM. The one case roxmltree 0.21.2 accepts, rmt-ns10-032 (`xmlns:xmlns` declared), is refused by a new check (Namespaces 1.0 §3), so the list of accepted cases is empty and the parser's leniencies within the suite form a closed, reviewed list. Valid and invalid XML 1.0 and NS 1.0 cases that reach the root stage are never refused as `Malformed` (a guard against an over-strict scan).
